title: Database lock timeouts and deadlocks hit background workers all day, not only during rollouts
whatHappens: Background jobs (skill anchoring, Sentry wakes, check refresh, push clear, cleanup) stop on lock timeouts or deadlocks and retry later; the same contention stops the release migration.

observations.text: Sentry, 3-4 Nov: 12 issues (lock timeouts, deadlocks, connect timeouts), 1-3 events each, 0 users, spread from 12:49 to 10:06 UTC. Log walk: 270 skill-anchor lock timeouts, 17 Sentry-wake and 14 check re-read failures; about 72,000 slow-query lines, mostly one agent command recovery query.
